description: This file defines an Orleans Grain interface and its implementation for managing stream lease responsibilities, including lease acquisition, renewal, release, and responsibility tracking in a distributed streaming system.

classes.name: ILeaseManagerGrain
classes.description: Interface defining lease management operations for stream provider.

classes.name: LeaseManagerGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a lease manager grain handling lease acquisition, renewal, release, and responsibility tracking.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain's state, including dependency injection and lease map setup.

methods.name: GetLeaseResposibility
methods.description: Calculates the responsibility of this silo based on current leases and silo count.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Finds and assigns an unallocated lease to a requester.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews the lease for a given lease number.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a lease, marking it as unassigned.

methods.name: SetQueuesAsLeases
methods.description: Initial setup of leases for given queue IDs.

methods.name: RecordBalancerResponsibility
methods.description: Records which balancer is responsible for a number of queues, used for test assertions.

methods.name: GetResponsibilityMap
methods.description: Retrieves the current responsibility map for balancers.
